name: [AddonRepo] Regression tests for the deployment pipeline
description:
## Summary

The addon deployment pipeline has no regression coverage, so a change to the pipeline itself can break partner deployments and nothing catches it before release. This task adds automated tests that exercise the deploy path end to end against a reference addon repository: a clean deploy succeeds, a deliberately broken addon is rejected rather than half-published, and the published output is what the repository actually contained. There is already a fixture repository available for this purpose (roman-talas-snowly-code/addon-review-fixture) plus a CI sandbox repository, so the test subjects do not need to be invented. The tests must run before a pipeline release, not on a schedule afterwards. Depends on the Vercel migration so the tests are written against the target infrastructure rather than being rewritten twice.

## Why?

A change to the pipeline can currently break every partner deployment with nothing standing in the way. The first signal would be a partner report, which is the same detection gap the monitoring task addresses, only avoidable earlier and more cheaply.

## What?

An automated test suite covers the deploy path against a reference addon and runs as a gate before a pipeline release. A broken pipeline change fails the gate instead of reaching partners.

## Acceptance Criteria

A clean deploy of the reference addon is covered by an automated test

A deliberately broken addon is rejected, with no partially published output

The published output is asserted against the repository contents, not just a success exit code

The suite runs as a gate before any pipeline release

A failing gate blocks the release rather than only reporting
